test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'LOVING' is coded as 'HOJWPM' and 'EAGLE' is coded as 'FMHBF'. What is the code for the word 'TRUTHFUL' in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (1) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series diagonally.

​So,

 
• 'LOVING' is coded as 'HOJWPM'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3a94660ec3906f95c655a538e3e95e8cb72d69c54109d8b73b5800648fbdfd3.png] 

And,

 
• 'EAGLE' is coded as 'FMHBF'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aac2be9a94283ecc7a9809269cf8c4f8e511d2e37cce6635b99856822a02ee56.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'TRUTHFUL' is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cc7c58ddff7fbdc968c5fd97d2dc17b8d7c4f5077c0db46555b02b73a16842f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**MVGIUVSU**".
